purpose: Separate dynamic repository truth, observed deployment truth and historical rollback anchors. Specialist source controls remain authoritative for proposition-level detail.

authority.current_repository_truth: Resolve refs/heads/main through GitHub or local git at execution time.
authority.current_deployment_truth: Resolve the latest successful GitHub Pages run and, where material, verify the public host.
authority.historical_rollback_truth: Use ops/LAST_KNOWN_GOOD.json and ops/RELEASE_LEDGER.json; never treat a rollback anchor as current merely because it was once live-verified.

repository_observation.relationship_rule: The observed SHA must remain an ancestor of the checked-out commit. A live runtime report supersedes this last observation.

repository_inventory_observation.source: GitHub search API: repo:sbu001monterecco/por-derecho is:pr is:open
repository_inventory_observation.meaning: Observation only; always re-query before triage or merge decisions.

boundaries: This file does not certify that the last observation is still the current GitHub state.
A successful Pages build is not the same as route-specific public-content verification.
Historical live verification remains valid as historical evidence but does not make that SHA current.
Open pull requests are candidate deltas, not repository truth.
No case allegation, procedural status or private-source conclusion is inferred from operational metadata.
